schema.title: orderMessage

description:
Subject: Order ORD1234 – Delivery Date Issue (Error – Action Required)

Dear Buyer,

We have detected an error on your order (reference code **ORD1234**) concerning the **deliveryDate** field for item **A12**. The system reports the following: *“The requested delivery date is earlier than the earliest possible shipping date.”* This condition is classified as an **ERROR** (object type: **orderError**) and must be corrected before the order can proceed. Please submit an updated order with a revised delivery date at your earliest convenience, as the correction is required to resolve this issue.

reference_json.messageInformation: The requested delivery date is earlier than the earliest possible shipping date.
